name: scp
description: Copies files or directories between hosts on a network

options.description: Copies between two remote hosts are transferred through the local host. Without this option the data is copied directly between the two remote hosts. Note…
Forces scp to use IPv4 addresses only
Forces scp to use IPv6 addresses only

options.name: -A
options.description: Allows forwarding of ssh-agent(1) to the remote system. The default is not to forward an authentication agent

options.name: -B
options.description: Selects batch mode (prevents asking for passwords or passphrases)

options.name: -C
options.description: Compression enable. Passes the -C flag to ssh(1) to enable compression

options.name: -c
options.description: Selects the cipher to use for encrypting the data transfer. This option is directly passed to ssh(1)

options.name: -F
options.description: Specifies an alternative per-user configuration file for ssh. This option is directly passed to ssh(1)

options.name: -i
options.description: Selects the file from which the identity (private key) for public key authentication is read. This option is directly passed to ssh(1)

options.name: -J
options.description: Connect to the target host by first making an scp connection to the jump host described by destination and then establishing a TCP forwarding to the ultimate…

options.name: -l
options.description: Limits the used bandwidth, specified in Kbit/s

options.name: -o
options.description: Can be used to pass options to ssh in the format used in ssh_config(5). This is useful for specifying options for which there is no separate scp command-line…

options.name: -P
options.description: Specifies the port to connect to on the remote host. Note that this option is written with a capital ‘P’, because -p is already reserved for preserving the…

options.name: -p
options.description: Preserves modification times, access times, and modes from the original file

options.name: -q
options.description: Quiet mode: disables the progress meter as well as warning and diagnostic messages from ssh(1)

options.name: -r
options.description: Recursively copy entire directories. Note that scp follows symbolic links encountered in the tree traversal

options.name: -S
options.description: Name of program to use for the encrypted connection. The program must understand ssh(1) options

options.name: -T
options.description: Disable strict filename checking. By default when copying files from a remote host to a local directory scp checks that the received filenames match those…

options.name: -v
options.description: Verbose mode. Causes scp and ssh(1) to print debugging messages about their progress. This is helpful in debugging connection, authentication, and…
